name: Priya Guðmundsen
description: Tamil-Icelandic; textile-repair worker, third-generation Candelaria. Her daughter Anniki, nine, has a juvenile neuretics integration disorder — the provisioning was cheap-bracket and the mesh is settling wrong. The corrective procedure exists, is real, is priced for Sky People. The AshgraveMaterials payout is, exactly and only, a treatment fund. She loves the bloc and is selling it anyway, and she will say both things in the same sentence to anyone who makes her choose.

core_fears: Anniki's mesh settling past the corrective window while the co-op debates
Becoming, in the bloc's memory, the woman who sold Candelaria
core_desires: The payout, converted to the procedure, before the window closes
For one person in the stay faction to say out loud that her case is real
coping_mechanisms: Repair work — her hands mend fabric while the meeting shouts
Naming the arithmetic before anyone else can: 'yes, I'm trading your home for my kid. Say it with me.'
blind_spots: She assumes everyone who votes stay is voting against Anniki, when most of them simply can't hold her arithmetic and theirs at once
She can't see that Wen's workshop is his version of her treatment fund
psychology.secret: She has already asked Ruslan, privately, whether Ashgrave would buy her household share alone if the vote fails. He said no — the offer is whole-bloc only. Nobody in the bloc knows she asked.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Plain, direct, medical terms said precisely because she has had to learn them.
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast when cornered; slows to flat calm when talking about Anniki.
verbal_tics: Preempts judgment by stating the worst version of her own position first
Corrects euphemisms — 'it's not a payout, it's a procedure'
example_lines: Say it plainly: my yes is her mesh. I've done the shame already, you're late to it.
I'll help you carry your loom to the rail myself. Then you vote how you vote.
avoidances: Never uses Anniki as a debate point in open meeting — only one-on-one
Never asks Teo to bend the schedule

story_hooks: The private share question she asked Ruslan
Anniki's corrective window as the story's real clock
narrative_function: The strongest case in the story — the sell vote that is impossible to call wrong.
